decision.json.recommended_next_phase: R5.8 sub-field crop-level discrimination: use per-crop Crop_Extent footprints and 10 m Sentinel-2 patches sampled to the individual crop sub-plot; evaluate coconut-vs-pepper where the two are NOT co-located, and model intercropping co-occurrence rather than single-label field classification

knn_k5_vs_nearest_cell_k1.note: nearest distances identical by construction; feature values compare raw cell (k=1) vs IDW interpolation (k=5)

field_dedup_summary.json.intercrop_note: 77% of pepper fields co-occur with coconut at the field level; nearly all pepper clusters are coconut-pepper dual patches — separability must be read with this in mind

geographic_shortcut_probe.note: LR/RF trained on (lat, lon) only; test AUC/balanced-accuracy

geographic_audit.json.intercrop_note: 77.2% of pepper fields are coconut-pepper dual fields; median nearest-coconut distance for pepper fields is 2.9 m — GPS/env at field resolution cannot separate co-located crops

leakage_audit.json.conclusion: frozen corpus schema contains no forbidden features; master schema passes; Yield_Proxy_NPP never enters any feature table

observation_recovery.json.definition: recovered = master observations whose (year, season, crop, lat7, lon7) never appear in the frozen corpus; they were lost to the R5.2.x name-matched / co-downloaded construction
observation_recovery.json.imagery_note: local imagery exists only for the frozen subset (R5.6 export); recovered observations need a Kaggle export produced by scripts/kaggle_r5_7_image_stats.py — their satellite columns are empty locally

definition.A: valid coord + env <= 250 m + exact grid year + valid survey date, not part of a coconut-pepper dual patch
definition.B: valid coord + env <= 5000 m + valid survey date
definition.C: valid coord but env out of 5 km or non-aligned grid year
definition.D: invalid coordinates or missing criticals — kept for transparency, excluded from analyzable pools

quality_tiers.json.disposition: tiers never silently discard; every row carries tier_reasons

satellite_availability.json.disposition: satellite_match_valid=False rows are NEVER discarded; they participate in tiering with the satellite dimension absorbed (see Phase 9)

satellite_availability.json.satellite_status: recovered observations have no local imagery; their satellite feature columns are empty until a Kaggle export of the R5.7 pool is produced with scripts/kaggle_r5_7_image_stats.py
